description: Use this when a visitor asks for current posted ride waits or operating status at one supported park. Resolve the park ID first. Each entry has a type: ride (always listed; "unavailable", not closed, when no live value is reported), experience, show or meet (listed only while reported). This tool does not predict future waits.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

ride_id.description: Optional canonical ride ID to return one ride only.

name: parky_get_waits
title: Get current posted waits at a Parky park
